data_authentication: input rasters restored from hash-pinned owner mirrors; hashes establish byte integrity only, not organizer provenance
hypothesis: H38-1: shallow SI-0 Euler contact candidate within 200 m of a high gravity-gradient cell and in low local relief
interpretation: label-free data-support audit only; not a holdout result, fault identification, or score estimate

rule.euler: SI-0 cluster row and col rounded to nearest grid cell; depth_mad_m <= 60 m; median_depth_m <= 400 m; n_solutions >= 8
rule.gravity: training_features band 18 (iso_grav_anom_hg - Isostatic gravity anomaly horizontal gradient - horizontal rate of change); threshold is the 80% linear quantile of finite in-footprint values; candidate centroid within 2 pixels (200 m) of any threshold-exceeding cell
rule.relief: LiDAR band 9 (relief); value <= 50% linear quantile over valid in-footprint cells; validity band 12 (valid) > 0

support.gravity_population: finite (abs < 1e30) cells inside the finite template footprint
support.relief_population: finite LiDAR-valid cells inside the finite template footprint
